        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Build a connected components graph for the 4s

def get_connected_4s(start_r, start_c):
    """Get all 4s connected to (start_r, start_c) via orthogonal 4-neighbors"""
    visited = set()
    stack = [(start_r, start_c)]
    while stack:
        r, c = stack.pop()
        if (r, c) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((r, c))

            if 0 <= nr < len(d1_in) and 0 <= nc < len(d1_in[0]):
                if d1_in[nr][nc] == 4 and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    stack.append((nr, nc))
    return visited
